sources.title: AI at Meta: Meta AI Products, Models and Research
sources.snippet: Explore AI at Meta. Use Meta AI to answer questions, create images, and complete tasks for free. Plus AI research, models, and tools for developers.

sources.title: Fine-tuning | How-to guides - developer.meta.com
sources.snippet: Learn how to fine-tune Llama models using various methods, including LoRA, QLoRA, and reinforcement learning, to improve performance on specific tasks and adapt to domain-specific knowledge. Fine-tune Llama using libraries like PyTorch's torchtune, Hugging Face peft, Axolotl, and Unsloth.

sources.title: Example Projects for Fine-Tuning Models — NVIDIA AI Workbench User Guide
sources.snippet: These example projects demonstrate how to fine-tune various large language models (LLMs) and image generation models using NVIDIA AI Workbench. The following projects highlight: Fine-tuning of popular open-source models including Llama 2, Llama 3, Mistral, Mixtral, and Phi-3. Parameter-efficient fine-tuning techniques with NeMo Framework.
